name: web-lilac-3d-chrome-shapes-ai-protocol-landing-page
title: Lilac 3D Chrome AI Protocol Landing Page
whatItIs: A white landing page with a hero of a stepped lilac-to-violet gradient shape holding a chrome tri-blade 3D object, a two-column headline and text, a 'Gateway' section with a black card holding a ringed chrome logo and two lilac cards with chrome shapes, and an AI market section with a rosette and a partners row.
whatItMeans: Glossy chrome objects on lilac give a futuristic, precious feel, and the black card is a strong anchor.
techniques: Stepped pixel-like gradient staircase behind a 3D object
Chrome and violet 3D objects as brand illustrations
One black card among pale lilac cards
Minimal nav pill and dark CTA buttons
Partner logos row at the base

vocabulary.definition: A gradient built from stacked blocks that step in size.
A dark card placed among light ones for weight.
